Subject: Mutual plan + onboarding milestones for Dedicated GPU pool (EvoScale)

Hi Maria / Aaron —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. As promised, I pulled together a short mutual action plan to align timing, owners, and the throughput targets we're using for the Dedicated GPU pool trial. Draft attached (EvoScale_MAP_v0.1.pdf) and a throughput workbook (throughput_targets_v2.xlsx).

High-level ask: can we lock the initial onboarding window the week of July 9 and confirm the performance SLOs below so engineering can size the pool?

Planned milestones (proposal):
- Week of Jun 25: finalize security questionnaire + SOC2 evidence checklist (we'll share initial artifacts)
- Week of Jul 2: provision test GPU pool (1-2 nodes, 8xA100 equivalent) for evaluation runs
- Week of Jul 9: one-week trial with your AB tests / load script; daily syncs for ops tuning
- Week of Jul 16: close decision meeting (go/no-go + commitment options)

Throughput targets we used to size the pool:
- Target median latency: <= 120ms (95th <= 400ms) for 512-token requests
- Sustain throughput: 120k tokens/min across the pool during peak scenarios

Owners:
- Redwood: Vanessa (program lead), Dylan (runtime lead), Marissa (solutions & evals)
- EvoScale: Maria (product), Aaron (infra)

Please reply with any changes to dates or owners and feel free to redline the MAP PDF. If that window works, I’ll send calendar invites for the provisioning and daily syncs.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. AM, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0127
Redwood Inference

Attachments: EvoScale_MAP_v0.1.pdf (PDF, 95 KB); throughput_targets_v2.xlsx (Excel, 54 KB)

Vanessa —

Appreciate the clear plan and the attachments. High level: the dates look doable but we have two constraints on our side: 1) procurement needs a formal statement of work to start provisioning (we can turn that around in ~4 business days) and 2) our internal infra team prefers the trial start on Jul 11 instead of Jul 9 (they're at capacity week of Jul 9).

I'll loop in Aaron to confirm the infra availability; if we shift the trial to Jul 11 that still meets our decision timeline of mid-July. I'll also ask our security lead to review the SOC2 checklist this week.

Next steps from EvoScale:
- I will attach the procurement contact and expected SOW template by Wed 6/20.
- Aaron to confirm node-level availability by EOD 6/19.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can support a soft start on Jul 11 (three-day soak, then ramp to full traffic)?

Thanks,
Maria Gonzales
Head of Product, EvoScale
+1 (617) 555-9983

Quick clarifying notes from runtime team (cc'd Maria to keep everyone aligned):

- The sizing in throughput_targets_v2.xlsx assumes model-family X (8b) with fp16 paths. If EvoScale intends to run larger variants during the trial we need to know now — a 70b-class model will increase node count by ~2.
- For the soft start Jul 11 -> Jul 13, we can do staged traffic: day 1 (10% traffic), day 2 (40%), day 3 (100%). We'll need the AB test script or a replay trace to pilot the ramp scheduling.
- Please confirm whether latency SLOs are absolute or if EvoScale wants a weighted SLO (e.g., 90% under 120ms, 95th under 450ms) — we can tune batching and prefix caching accordingly.

Also, I'll prepare a short ops runbook to share with EvoScale ahead of provisioning.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Principal Runtime Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Thanks for the quick responses. A few decisions / confirmations from Redwood: 

- We're fine shifting the trial start to Jul 11 and doing the 3-day soak as Dylan outlined.
- Throughput workbook note: Maria, if you expect to test both 8b and 70b variants please flag that in the SOW; otherwise we'll size for the 8b baseline.
- SLOs: Redwood proposes a weighted SLO: 90% <= 120ms, 95% <= 450ms for the trial. We can revisit post-eval.
- Procurement / SOW: I can draft an initial SOW template specific to the Dedicated trial and send to Maria and Aaron by EOB Wed (6/20).

Action items (owner / ETA):
- Maria: share procurement contact + SOW template (ETA 6/20)
- Aaron: confirm infra availability for Jul 11 start (ETA 6/19)
- Dylan: ops runbook + AB test runner requirements (ETA 6/22)
- Vanessa: Redwood SOW draft + calendar invites for provisioning and daily syncs (ETA 6/20)

I’ve attached an updated MAP summary (EvoScale_MAP_v0.1.pdf) with owners called out inline. I’ll send the SOW draft in a follow-up.

Best,
Vanessa
